feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 14 November 2026 11:45am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Saturday, 14 November 2026 at 11:45am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds.


##Synopsis##

High pressure over central Europe extending a ridge across the Irish Sea. Low pressure develops to the west of Ireland.


##Wind##

South or southwest 5 to 7, though a force lower in the southeast of the area. Decreasing south or southeast 4 or 5 overnight.


##State of Sea##

Moderate or rough, becoming slight or moderate later.


##Weather##

Scattered showers, then rain arriving overnight.


##Visibility##

Moderate or good, occasionally poor in rain later.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

South or southeast 4 or 5, veering north or northwest 6 to gale 8 Sunday late afternoon and evening. Then decreasing 4 or 5 overnight into Monday.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, becoming moderate or rough Sunday evening for a time.


##Weather##

Outbreaks of rain, clearing to showers later on Sunday.


##Visibility##

Moderate or good, occasionally poor at first.
